items.title: Nvidia CEO return sparks market rally
items.summary: The ASX 200 has snapped its eight-day losing streak off the back of a global rally, sparked by the reinstatement of Nvidia chief Jensen Huang.

items.title: The S&P 500 Lost More Than 8% in a Week for Only the 13th Time Since 1950. Here's How the Other 12 Played Out.
items.summary: Eight of the earlier 12 left the index up a year later. Is this as comforting as it seems?

items.title: Queensland tungsten mine to supply critical mineral to US military
items.summary: A tungsten mine in Far North Queensland will become a key supplier to the US Department of Defense as part of major expansion plans.

aus.headline: ASX Snaps Losing Streak
aus.body: The ASX 200 ended an eight-day slide amid a global rally after Huang's Nvidia return.
aus.why: Local shares sit in most Australians' super funds.

us.headline: S&P 500 Suffers Rare 8% Week
us.body: The S&P 500 fell over 8% in one week, only the 13th time that has happened since 1950.
us.why: Many Australians hold US shares through their super.

biz.headline: Qld Tungsten Mine Lands US Deal
biz.body: A Far North Qld tungsten miner will help supply the US Defense Department as it expands.
biz.why: It ties a local critical minerals project to a major US customer.
